text:
alex: Heads-up — planning kernel swap + small quant-profile tweak for runtime slices in us-west tomorrow 2026-03-18 22:00 UTC. Need a clear deploy owner, smoke checklist, and rollback owner. Who can take?
priya: I can be deploy owner for the 22:00 window, unless Sam has bandwidth. I'll own canary + smoke.
sam: I can be rollback owner on stand-by. Canary slice list? How many pods are we rotating?
alex: Thanks. Plan is 4 canary slices (slices 2,5,7,9) then gradual roll to remaining 40. Kernel bump is minor (patch r1.2.3 -> r1.2.4). Quant change is a conservative 8-bit tuning for embedding path.
jo: @priya quick ask — for the smoke, confirm KV cache warm path is enabled and we run the 30s perf-run test. Also need prediff of tail-latency metrics.
priya: Yep — smoke steps (short):
```
1) Deploy to slices 2 and 5 only
2) Run kv-cache warm sequence (curl /warm with sample prefixes)
3) Run load test: 100 qps for 30s (script: tools/loadtest/quick_30s.sh)
4) Check dashboards: p50/p95/p99, token rate, error-rate, OOMs
5) Run functional eval against prompt-set "smoke-small"
```
sam: For rollback: if p99 increases > 30% or error-rate > 0.5% within 10m across canary, we rollback. I'll trigger the rollback and coordinate with infra.
maya: FYI: I queued a quick canary config PR: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pulls/4821 — includes kernel flag and quant-profile id qprof-20260317-a. Needs one more review from eng-runtime.
alex: @deploy-bot can you reserve the 22:00 slot and annotate owner=priya?
deploy-bot: Slot reserved: 2026-03-18T22:00:00Z. Metadata: owner=priya, rollback_owner=sam, canary_slices=[2,5,7,9], runbook=/runbooks/engine-roll-kernel-quant.md :white_check_mark:
priya: I'll post a brief preflight msg 1 hour before with telemetry baselines. Also doing a tiny rehearsal today at 17:00 UTC on staging (non-prod) to validate the warm path and quick_30s script.
jo: One more — please add a smoke-step to validate streaming decode behavior (we saw rare truncation after last bump). Run `scripts/stream-check.sh` during canary.
priya: added.
alex: Cool. If nobody objects, we proceed with that owner handoff. Any objections?
maya: No objections. +1 on the PR review, I'll leave a comment.
sam: All good from infra side. I'll be on pager during the window.
alex: thanks everyone — I'll drop the timezone-friendly reminder in #eng-runtime 30m before. :thumbsup:
